QuestInfo.name: Excavated: Wayfinder
QuestInfo.0: You found one of Spiegelmann's lost tools while you were looking for artifacts.
QuestInfo.1: Bring this back to Spiegelmann. He'll probably be excited!
QuestInfo.2: Spiegelmann was so excited about the return of his compass that he wrote you a poem. Only none of it rhymed, or was poetic, or was a poem.

0.0: Hey, I'm composing a poem... Where is north? Which way is east? As my hand turns, you'll fight a beast! Wait, no, eat a feast! That's terrible... I have to admit, I don't know from poems.

no.0: What do you think about directions? Are you for, or against them?

1.0: You'll never find your way around the site without a compass! I know I sure can't... I seriously can't even find the refrigerator without mine. I haven't eaten anything that wasn't part of one of my shoes in a week!
